lamejs / LAME acknowledgement

This private YouCue build bundles lamejs (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs)
for local MP3 encoding.

The upstream repository states:

Can I use LAME in my commercial program?

Yes, you can, under the restrictions of the LGPL. The easiest way is to:
1. Link to LAME as a separate file (lame.min.js or lame.all.js).
2. Fully acknowledge that you are using LAME, and give a link to
   lame.sourceforge.net.
3. If you modify LAME, release those modifications back to the LAME project
   under the LGPL.

YouCue does not modify lame.min.js.
